note: PlayHand and DiscardHand events are expanded into SelectCard steps ordered by the player's original card-selection order (position_in_zone in CurrentHandSelected), followed by a final commit action. The unselected card pool in current_hand is shuffled at each step.

SelectCard_only.step_index: int — 0-based index within the selection sequence
SelectCard_only.source_action: str — PlayHand | DiscardHand (the original action being decomposed)
SelectCard_only.target_card: object — the card being selected at this step
SelectCard_only.selected_cards: [object] — cards selected in prior steps (in selection order)

commit_step_only.step_index: int — equals number of selected cards (final step)
commit_step_only.selected_cards: [object] — all selected cards in selection order

card_object_fields.card: null | {rank, rank_index, suit, suit_index, is_ace, is_face}
card_object_fields.edition: null | str — e_foil | e_holo | e_negative | e_polychrome
card_object_fields.modifier: null | str — m_bonus | m_glass | m_gold | m_lucky | m_mult | m_steel | m_stone | m_wild
card_object_fields.seal: null | str — blue_seal | gold_seal | purple_seal | red_seal
